name: RouterArena
description: RouterArena is an open platform designed for comprehensive comparison of LLM routers. It features a principled dataset with broad knowledge domain coverage, distinguishable difficulty levels, extensive evaluation metrics, and an automated evaluation and leaderboard framework.
reputation: A new open benchmark for evaluating LLM routers, positioned as a comprehensive leaderboard-style platform for routing research.
notes: Includes a principled dataset, broad domain coverage, multiple difficulty levels, and an automated leaderboard for LLM router evaluation.
